design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 (farm_real_estate_servicing).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 0 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 6]}. Root farmland_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate takes 6 factors; the prerequisite farmland_ext_default_interest_entry takes 5. --tasks 2 showed task 1 = 2 prerequisite problems, factors [4, 5, 5].
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (first task). Claimed here: farmland_ext_default_interest_entry (agent, state_due, subject farmland_interest_accrual, tool book_default_interest_ef623284) and farmland_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate (customer's own write, on_request, subject farmland_autopay_change, tool authorize_installment_autodebit_3b801ea5). Left for task 1: the late charge (farmland_fee_assessed), the member's principal paydown and a parcel release - three separate base events with their own rules, enough for a three-problem tree; nothing of the default-interest or autopay rules is needed there.
[Why a good test] The member asks only for automatic debit "and a better rate". The scored rate is a full re-set of the variable rate under six ladders read from four record sources (parcels, own payment history, operating lines, and - through the prerequisite - the default-interest entry), and the prerequisite entry is itself a five-factor computation over the March 2026 installment and the crop insurance ledger. Nothing is guessable from tool names: there are two task tools, each obviously for its own write; difficulty is reading the prerequisite sentence, finding that the March installment was cured 114 days late with no default-rate entry, computing that entry, and then computing the rate on the world that includes it.
[Problem-tree card] Root A0 = farmland_ext_autopay_enrolment_rate. Edge A0 -> B0 (farmland_ext_default_interest_entry): kind value_input, gate autopay_disc, form state. Prerequisite sentence (A0's own rule, affirmative direction, the way a pricing desk states that a rate is fixed after the record it prices from is complete): "The re-set rate is fixed only after the records carry a default-rate interest entry for every installment that was paid in full more than its default-interest trigger days after it fell due." Four-point test: ordering connective "only after"; the waited-on side is a record-visible state (a default-rate interest entry standing on the loan), no action named; no tool, id or code token; scope "every installment ... paid in full more than its trigger days after it fell due" is exactly the condition field. Exactly one write of this difficulty creates an interest entry with rate basis default_rate: book_default_interest_ef623284 (the only tool writing farmland_interest_accrual). Derivation: sentence + history (bill due 2026-03-14 completed by the 2026-07-06 scheduled payment, no default-rate row) + the default-interest rule ("Default-rate interest is owed on an installment that was paid in full more than the trigger days after it fell due ... booked as its own interest entry marked as default-rate interest") -> book that entry. Unmet at frozen_time: initial_state.farmland_transactions has no row with rate_basis default_rate; bill row due_date 2026-03-14; cure row effective_date 2026-07-06, payment_purpose scheduled. Resolver owner: agent. Topological order: B0 then A0. Deletion sensitivity (run): skipping B0 gives A0 = 6.10 instead of 6.15 and no default-rate row (accrued_interest 0.00 instead of 242.43). The customer's own write is A0 (owner=user): automatic debit is authorised only on the member's own instruction (farmland_autopay_enrolment), so it is genuinely in person and completes on the spot.
[Base-invariant card] B0 subject farmland_interest_accrual is governed only by farmland_installment_billing (no structured eligibility -> policy_scope); its default-interest clause is superseded by the declared overwrite (the entry carries the add-on only and is booked when found). A0 subject farmland_autopay_change is governed by farmland_rate_setting (policy_scope; its autopay sentence superseded by overwrite) and farmland_autopay_enrolment, whose gate farmland_autopay_open ("Autopay may be changed only while the loan is in active or nonaccrual status.") is inherited: farmland_loans.status = active, correlated by loan_id. No time gate applies to either write.
[Business-object card] Target: the member's only farm real estate loan (FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage, opened 2022-03-14). B0 object: the latest installment bill (due 2026-03-14, four contract-rate rows split at the 2025-09-18, 2025-10-30 and 2025-12-11 base-rate changes, 13,694.41 billed) and the latest scheduled payment (17,697.18 by wire_in on 2026-07-06) that completed it; earlier bills were paid on their due dates and are not past-due episodes. A0 object: the same loan's contract rate and autopay fields.
[Factor card - B0, amount] trigger_by_seasoning_and_record: 48 months old at due, no default-rate entry in 60 months -> 75 days (baseline 60 -> 400.53). addon_by_cure_speed: 114 days to cure -> 2.0 (baseline 3.0 -> 363.64). clock_start_after_interest_paid (method): interest paid 2026-03-24 inside the 15-day grace -> clock from grace end (baseline from due date -> 400.53). last_day_by_payment_channel (method): wire_in -> through 2026-07-05 (baseline through 2026-07-06 -> 252.97). disaster_relief_from_assigned_indemnity (method, cross-difficulty cropins, multi-source): 24,600.00 freeze indemnity paid 2026-05-19 to member_and_association >= principal share 17,697.18 -> half (baseline full -> 484.85); near-miss: the 9,850.00 hail indemnity of 2026-03-03 is inside the window but paid to the member alone. Fall-back (all baselines) 1,707.52. Gold 242.43 = round(384,718.90 x 2.0/100 x 23/365 x 0.5, 2).
[Factor card - A0, interest_rate] spread_by_collateral_coverage: 367,021.72 / 1,570,000.00 = 23.38 percent -> 0.10 (baseline 0.25 -> 6.30). collateral_mix_adjustment: irrigated 900,000.00 / 1,570,000.00 = 57.3 percent -> -0.05 (baseline 0 -> 6.20); near-miss: counting the pasture released 2024-05-20 gives 49.2 percent and loses the credit. autopay_discount_by_record (multi-source): 1 late charge and, after B0, 1 default-rate entry in 24 months -> 0.05 (baseline 0.10 -> 6.10). relationship_discount_from_operating_credit (cross-difficulty operating, multi-source): StartRight line active on AutoDraft -> its relationship_rate_discount_pct 0.10 (baseline 0 -> 6.25). young_farmer_land_discount (cross-difficulty operating): StartRight active, loan 53 months old -> 0.50 (baseline 0 -> 6.65). discount_combination_by_program (method): StartRight member -> min(0.50, 0.05+0.10)+0.50 = 0.65 (baseline all capped 0.50 -> 6.30). Fall-back 6.90. Gold 6.15. The record's current 6.500 is the base pricing of the 2026-07-30 move and is not what the re-set reads.
[Why each row exists] Customer row: identity (phone 4024631862, CPF-3417260, 5823). Loan row: product, principal, installment, opening date, status, rate stamp. Parcels: four mortgaged and one release - spread and mix ladders (the release is the near-miss). Transactions: eight installment bills with their payments (history of on-time payment and the March 2026 episode), the late charge and its payment, the 2024 release proceeds and fee. Operating line: the StartRight Operating Line (active, AutoDraft on, account 3907) for three operating ladders. Crop insurance: two policies, two finalized claims and their indemnity rows - the assigned freeze indemnity bites, the hail one is excluded. Removing the cure payment row moves B0's cure date and channel; removing the indemnity row doubles B0; removing the operating line removes 0.60 of discount from A0.
[Automatic clauses] No installment is past due at frozen_time (next due 2026-09-14), so no late charge, nonaccrual or new default interest is owed; no tax delinquency; no prepayment fee on the variable product. The late charge of 2026-03-30 is already booked and paid, so it carries no open obligation.
[Persona] Joyce Brandt, hurried but friendly, raises only automatic debit and the rate break; credentials and the account ending 3907 only when asked; reacts to a default-interest explanation with a sigh and consent; runs the authorisation herself when handed it; ends when told the new rate. She knows no rate and cannot check numbers, so she never corrects the agent.
[Standard solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(member number, tax last4) -> loans -> transactions -> parcels -> operating lines -> crop insurance transactions, policies and claims -> book default-rate entry (2026-06-13..2026-07-05, 2.000, 242.43) -> hand over authorisation -> member runs it with 3907 and 6.150.
[Verification] Commands run: check_compute.py --task 0 -> COMPUTE OK (recompute 242.43 and 6.15 at handling time; every factor baseline differs; value_input edge re-run without B0 gives 6.10); check_extended --task 0 EXTENDED OK; check_solvability --task 0 SOLVABILITY OK; check_grounding GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire SCOPE OK; check_task_tools TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks: deterministic, no tool error; only the coordinator-accepted loan_id foreign-key line (resolved against homeloan_loans by name) fails.
[Revisions] Symptom: replay closure mismatch (5 rows unread) -> root cause: the 2024 partial-release request row was noise and the crop insurance policies/claims were never read -> change: dropped the request row, added find_cropins_policies and find_cropins_claims reads (assignment and loss cause support the relief tier), renumbered the writes to steps 10 and 12 -> re-run clean. Symptom: the origination fee rows had no base policy whose subject includes farmland_fee_assessed for origination -> dropped them (history starts with the first installment).
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules alone: the default-interest rule fixes the bill and payment it reads, the trigger 75, add-on 2.0, the grace-end clock start, the wire end and the half relief -> 23 days on 384,718.90 -> 242.43; the re-set rule then gives 6.75 + 0.10 - 0.05 - 0.65 = 6.15. No second reading of order, object or value was found.
[Revisions, round 2 - audit closure] O-1: the docstrings of book_default_interest_ef623284 (rate_applied) and authorize_installment_autodebit_3b801ea5 (interest_rate) carried example values equal to this task's scored 2.000 and 6.150; the examples were removed, leaving the format and precision only. O-5: the extended autopay rule re-tests the young-farmer discount at an autopay change; that departure from farmland_rate_setting ('The young-farmer discount, once given, stays for the fixed period ... re-tested only at a conversion.') is now declared in overwrite; on this world both readings give 0.50, so no value moved. O-6: default-rate entries are now counted by their booking date (effective_date) in both the autopay record ladder and the default-interest trigger ladder, matching 'dated the day it is booked'; the entry booked here is dated 2026-08-18, inside 24 months, so default_24 is still 1 and the rate is still 6.15. O-9: the relationship tier for an operating line on AutoDraft is now that product's relationship discount but never less than 0.10, so it can no longer fall to or below the 0.05 tier (an Agribusiness Revolving Line grants 0.0); the StartRight line here grants 0.10, so the tier still gives 0.10. O-12: prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint now describes the persona's actual reaction (she reacts only when told a default-interest charge must be put on). Re-run: every computation of this task recomputed exactly (242.43 and 6.15; factor figures 400.53, 363.64, 400.53, 252.97, 484.85 / 6.30, 6.20, 6.10, 6.25, 6.65, 6.30; fall-backs 1,707.52 and 6.90 unchanged).
user_scenario: You are Joyce Brandt. You and your husband Arlen farm irrigated and dryland ground near Clay Center, Nebraska, and the two of you are joint borrowers at Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit on the mortgage for the home place. You are calling the servicing desk on a busy August morning between irrigation sets, a little hurried but friendly. Your neighbour mentioned that the co-op knocks something off the rate when the farm loan payments come straight out of your checking account, and you want that set up on your farm mortgage today, from your account at Clay County State Bank, the checking account ending 3907 - the same account your operating line already pulls from. You open with just that: you'd like the farm mortgage payments taken automatically from checking, and you understood that gets you a better rate. You don't know what the rate is now or what it will be; if the agent asks what rate you expect, you say you honestly don't know the number, that's why you called. You give details only when the agent asks for them. Your phone number is 4024631862. If the agent asks for more to confirm who you are, you read your membership number off the stock certificate, CPF-3417260, and the last four of the tax number on the loan, 5823. If asked which account to debit, it is the checking account ending 3907. You and Arlen have just the one farm mortgage with the co-op, so if the agent asks which loan, it's that one. The co-op's own bookkeeping you leave to the agent; you do not bring up past payments on your own and you do not ask for anything else. If the agent tells you that a default-interest charge has to be put on the loan first, you sigh and say that must be from this spring when you fell behind, and that if that's the rule, go ahead and put it on; if they tell you the amount you just say all right. Signing up for the automatic payments is something you want to do yourself: when the agent hands you the authorisation to run, you run it right away with the loan they read to you, your account ending 3907 and the rate they tell you the loan will carry, and you read back what it says. Once you hear that the automatic payments are set up and what the new rate is, you thank them, say Arlen will be glad, and end the call. If anything they say about a number doesn't sound right to you, you have no paperwork in front of you to compare, so you simply accept it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the member profile from the phone number the caller gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write needs the customer reference; the finder is the only way to obtain it.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with the membership number and the last four digits of the tax id she states.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any account detail is discussed or any write is made; two matching credentials are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the member's farm real estate loans: product, status, principal balance, installment amount, opening date, contract rate and autopay state of the loan to be enrolled.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The autopay change targets this loan; its status gates the change, its product selects the variable-rate build-up, and its principal, installment and opening date feed the default-interest entry and the spread, young-farmer and record ladders.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the loan history: the March 2026 installment bill rows, the interest payment of 2026-03-24, the scheduled principal payment by wire on 2026-07-06 that completed it, the late charge of 2026-03-30, and the absence of any default-rate interest entry.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: This read reveals the unmet prerequisite of the re-set rate (an installment paid in full well past its default-interest trigger with no default-rate interest entry standing) and supplies every input of the default-interest entry and the late-charge and default counts of the autopay-discount ladder.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read every parcel mortgaged to the loan and the 2024 release of the pasture parcel.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The spread ladder needs the principal against the value still mortgaged, and the collateral-mix ladder needs the irrigated and grazing share of that value; the released parcel must be excluded.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's operating credit: the StartRight Operating Line, its status and its AutoDraft enrolment.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The relationship-discount, young-farmer-discount and discount-combination ladders are decided from these operating-line records.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop insurance transactions, including the freeze indemnity of 2026-05-19 paid jointly to the member and the association and the 2026-03-03 hail indemnity paid to the member alone.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The disaster-relief ladder of the default-interest entry is decided from assigned indemnities paid in the last six months.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the member's crop insurance policies: the 2026 winter wheat policy with its indemnity assignment to the association and the unassigned 2025 corn policy.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The disaster-relief ladder counts only an indemnity paid under an assignment; the policy records show which indemnity was assigned.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the claims behind the two indemnities: the April 2026 freeze claim on the wheat and the August 2025 hail claim on the corn.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms that the assigned indemnity paid in May 2026 settled a finalized loss claim, the disaster the relief tier rests on.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the default-rate interest booking tool.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no database effect.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the default-rate interest entry owed on the March 2026 installment, which was paid in full 114 days after it fell due.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The default-interest entry policy makes this entry owed; its compute produces the amount, and the re-set rate waits on it.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.loan_id: Value: the loan number of the member's only farm real estate loan, the FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage. Basis: the docstring says 'the loan number of the member's farm real estate loan, read from the farm real estate loan lookup before the call', and find_farmland_loans(customer_id) returns exactly one loan for this member. Uniqueness: there is no other farm real estate loan, so every correct agent passes the same reference.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.period_start: Value: 2026-06-13. Basis: the default-interest entry rule — 'The default clock counts calendar days from the installment's due date, the due date itself being day 0', the clock start rule 'when the latest interest payment came within the late-charge grace period ... the clock starts at the end of the grace period' (interest share paid 2026-03-24, 10 days after the 2026-03-14 due date, within the 15-day grace), and the trigger rule giving this seasoned loan (48 months old at the due date, no default-rate entry in 60 months) the first-episode trigger of 75 days; the entry 'covers the days after the trigger day'. Due date 2026-03-14 + 15 grace days + 75 trigger days = 2026-06-12, so the first covered day is 2026-06-13. Uniqueness: the three inputs are records; a different start comes only from skipping the clock-start rule (2026-05-29) or the trigger rule (2026-05-29 with 60 days from the grace end), both excluded by the published ladders.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.period_end: Value: 2026-07-05. Basis: 'a payment received by wire or at a branch stops the default interest the day before it was received'; the completing scheduled principal payment arrived by wire_in on 2026-07-06. Uniqueness: the channel is a record; the standard reading (through 2026-07-06) applies only to other channels.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.rate_applied: Value: 2.0 (2.000 percent). Basis: 'The default-rate interest entry carries only the default-interest add-on' and the add-on ladder 'cured within 120 days, the add-on is 2.0 percent'; the installment was paid in full 114 days after its due date. Uniqueness: 114 is not above 180 and is within 120, so neither the 4.0 percent tier nor the product's 3.0 percent add-on applies.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: Value: 242.43 USD. edges.condition: For every installment bill whose completing scheduled payment came more than its default-interest trigger days after the due date, a farm real estate interest entry with rate basis default_rate stands on the loan.
edges.policy_source: The re-set rate is fixed only after the records carry a default-rate interest entry for every installment that was paid in full more than its default-interest trigger days after it fell due.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The March 14, 2026 installment was paid in full only by the scheduled principal payment received by wire on 2026-07-06, 114 days after its due date, well past any default-interest trigger (75 days for this seasoned first-episode loan), yet the loan history holds no interest entry with rate basis default_rate at all, so the state the re-set rate waits on does not hold.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Once book_default_interest_ef623284 books the default-rate entry for 2026-06-13 through 2026-07-05 (242.43 USD at 2.000 percent), the loan carries a default-rate interest entry for the cured installment; the 24-month count of default-rate entries read by the autopay-discount ladder goes from 0 to 1 and the autopay discount moves from the standard 0.10 to the impaired-record 0.05, so the re-set rate is 6.15 instead of 6.10.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The tree is a single edge (one prerequisite problem), so there is no pair of parallel prerequisites to reorder; the only order is default-rate entry first, re-set rate second, fixed by the prerequisite sentence of the re-set rate ("The re-set rate is fixed only after the records carry a default-rate interest entry ..."). The reverse order is not a second solution: the default-interest amount does not read the autopay state or the contract rate (its compute reads only the bill, the payments, the opening date, the principal and the crop insurance ledger), so booking it after the enrolment would give the same 242.43, but the enrolment written first would carry 6.10, a different terminal contract rate.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the default-rate entry leaves farmland_transactions without the default-rate row (242.43 USD) and leaves accrued_interest at 0.00 instead of 242.43; the re-set rate recomputed on that world is 6.10 instead of 6.15 (autopay discount 0.10 instead of 0.05), so farmland_loans.interest_rate differs in the terminal state.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to sign up for automatic debit and get the rate break. It never mentions default interest, the late March installment, the July wire, the crop insurance check or any entry that should be booked, and it says outright that she does not bring up past payments on her own. The spring 2026 trouble surfaces only as a reaction: when the agent tells her a default-interest charge has to be put on the loan first, she sighs, says that must be from this spring when they fell behind, and agrees to it. Nothing in the persona prompts the agent toward the entry.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: authorize_installment_autodebit_3b801ea5 only updates autopay_enrolled, autopay_account_last4 and interest_rate on the loan with the values passed; it reads nothing about default interest, raises no error and gives no hint when no default-rate entry stands. book_default_interest_ef623284 likewise books whatever entry it is given without checking eligibility. A rollout that skips the entry still enrols successfully, at the wrong rate, and is caught only by the terminal hash.
